title: Centered Full Indicator Fix
description: Fixes the off-to-the-right cross in a full attack indicator.
body:
# Notice

**I've started doing Minecraft commissions in my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/Ce6Vty6khA)!**

# Centered Full Indicator Fix
This pack centers the full attack indicator cross.
It has been miscentered by 0.5 pixels since 2016.
I suggest using this texture pack with my [Crosshair Enhancements](https://modrinth.com/mod/crosshair-enhancements-_-) mod.

## Trivia
A cyan color represents the final cross position, and a red one represents the vanilla position.
